exact_parity.method: Exact rational equality at unit mass and renormalization scale in authenticated FMFT master basis; no epsilon truncation or floating tolerance

protocol.mode_order: alternating between repetitions; sequential, never overlapping
protocol.scope: First public evaluate_integral call in a fresh process; retained masters, common symbolic mUVsq and FMFTandMATAD normalization. Excludes engine/data loading, cache attachment, input parsing and validation. FMFT includes version check, process launch, reduction, I/O and output parsing. Cache chunks are cold in-process; OS pages are not flushed.
